topics.title: Gary’s Cable Show Absurdity
topics.summary: A caller proposes bizarre segments for a cable show, including sex with a blow-up doll and requests involving hypnotized women and an elephant boy scorekeeper. The host engages in nonsensical conversations about potential guests and advertising opportunities, escalating into increasingly outlandish ideas like featuring topless ball girls.”} 09:41

topics.title: SternâDiscusses Celebrity Relationships
topics.summary: Howard Stern discusses celebrity relationships, including Judy’s new blonde hair and rumored gal pal Nancy. He then transitions to a comedic bit about visiting Larry King and his newlywed fiancée Julie, highlighting awkward questions and uncomfortable moments surrounding King's health and past behavior.

topics.title: Larry King Attempts Neil Young Interview
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, Larry King attempts an interview with Neil Young after fan requests. The conversation quickly becomes awkward as Young discusses past events like a disastrous pay-per-view special and his Marriott hotel booking plans for listeners, while also expressing vague praise.

topics.title: Gary’s Drug War Critique
topics.summary: Gary continues his lengthy critique of the drug war, expressing frustration with government spending and celebrity involvement in promoting it. He criticizes Hollywood’s role exacerbating the problem while referencing Todd Bridges' legal troubles and suggesting a more sympathetic approach to those struggling with addiction.

topics.title: Drug Testing & Dinkins Endorsements
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, hosts discuss New York City’s random drug testing program for police officers and its potential impact on crime rates. They then analyze mayoral candidate David Dinkins' growing celebrity endorsements including Ted Kennedy’s support alongside figures like Lena Horne and Eddie Palmieri, observing the rapid influx of supporters.

topics.title: Celebrity Phone Calls and MTV Awards Discussion
topics.summary: During the broadcast, hosts discuss numerous celebrity phone calls including John Mack Carter and Shuler Chapin alongside speculation about Paul Lynn’s death; they then transition into a discussion of the upcoming MTV Music Awards featuring performances by Paula Abdul and other artists. The conversation includes inappropriate jokes and commentary on various performers.
